scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Station X and Kinetic Force will both want to lead early, creating a contested pace scenario over this sharp 5f trip. The battle between these two front-runners should set up an honest gallop that will suit the hold-up horses like Havana Blast, Blinky, and Tiriac who can finish strongly if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Station X and Kinetic Force go too hard early in their speed duel
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other out in the first 2f, setting up a perfect storm for the closers. Hold-up horses get ideal positioning as the pace fades dramatically in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not suicidal between the front pair
scenarios.body: Sports Coach and Master Of My Fate get perfect positioning just off the leaders and kick clear. The hold-up brigade find themselves with too much to do over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Station X or Kinetic Force gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The winner of the early positioning battle gets first run and maintains the advantage to the line. Station X's better recent form gives him the edge over Kinetic Force in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get caught flat-footed as horses from midfield divisions make their move. This suits runners who can adapt their position like Mon Na Slieve and Reigning Profit.
